en: Colorized historic postcard view over a European town with many red-tiled roofs. In the right foreground stands a tall stone church tower with a green domed roof. In the left background, on a hill above the town, is a large Gothic cathedral-like complex with twin spires and adjoining castle buildings. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.
